newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean Yukong limit up in early trade.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean Yukong limit up in early trade.

text.p: Shares of South Korea's Yukong Ltd rose 5.5 percent or 1,100 won to their upper limit of 21,000 won on active early Monday morning buying, brokers said.
Investors were preparing for Tuesday's boost in the foreign shareholding ceiling, they added.
From Tuesday, foreigners will be able to hold up to 20 percent of shares on the Seoul bourse, up from the current 18 percent.
"The shares are also being boosted by news that Yukong has developed pollution filters for cars," said a Dongwon Securities broker.
Shares of businesses promoting environmentally-friendly products have recently been favoured by investors, brokers said.
